samples.question: The picture shows four solid horizontal ribbons, one above the other, numbered first, second, third and fourth from the top downwards. Each ribbon is a single connected band whose centre line wobbles gently and whose thickness, meaning its vertical height inside one column of pixels, changes along the ribbon from its left end to its right end. All four ribbons have the same length, the same total area of ink, the same thickness at their left end and the same thickness at their right end, and all four use exactly the same collection of thickness values; only the order in which those thicknesses occur along the ribbon differs. Read each ribbon from its left end to its right end. Exactly one ribbon never thickens again: at every point its thickness is no greater than every thickness already seen earlier in that same ribbon. Each of the other three ribbons has two separate interior stretches where it grows back thicker than it was before, and then thins again. Ribbon colour, ribbon length, ribbon position and total ink carry no information. Which ribbon thins steadily and never grows back thicker than it has already been? Answer with one of: first, second, third, fourth.
